issues.description: The problem UML and description indicate Animal.messageOnFeed() is a public abstract method (UML shows '+' visibility), but the solution declares it as protected (protected abstract String messageOnFeed()). This visibility mismatch can confuse students about the intended access level and expectations for implementing or calling the method from other classes (the UML implies public).
issues.suggestedFix: Make the abstract method visibility consistent with the UML/problem description. Either change Animal.messageOnFeed() in the solution to public (public abstract String messageOnFeed();) and update overrides accordingly, or update the UML/problem text to explicitly state protected visibility so students know protected is acceptable.
